questions.question: A loss of 26% gets converted into a profit of 24% when the selling price of a sanitizer bottle is increased by Rs. 185. The cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of the article be X.

In the case of 26% loss, the selling price of the article would have been 0.74X.

In the case of 24% profit, the selling price of the article would have been 1.24 X.

Now,

1.24X - 0.74X = Rs. 185

0.5X = Rs.185

X = Rs. 370

Hence, the cost price of the article is Rs. **370**.

questions.question:
Select the box (from 1, 2, 3, 4) that is similar to the box formed from the given sheet of paper.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a823428de304d311f2325e3a2ea20554c01f906cd826bc33cae5261c9608f8d3.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4877f7c82c450929bc2bb01ba1d269dc0a3315ef6fe764bbc988b5cbdb7c53be.png]
questions.solution:
In a dice or a cube, each side has four adjacent faces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd60e25f5c781ecf30ebb81f1d767dc8c2ef67cd4af37c96b7bd9002d2a4d254.png] 

In the first figure, '+' has two blank adjacent side. When we will form the box using the given paper, the dot and the circle will be the two adjacent side of '+'. The remaining two will be the blank side. Hence, the first figure is possible.

In the second figure, '+' has two adjacent sides, one is a dot and the other is a blank side. As mentioned above, it is also possible.

In the third figure, the circle has two adjacent sides, one is a dot and the other is the blank side. Clearly, the circle will be adjacent to the dot and at least on blank side will be adjacent to the circle. Hence, this box is also possible.

The fourth figure is basically the same as the third figure except for the fact that it is rotated. Hence, the fourth figure is also possible.

Hence, **1, 2, 3, and 4** are possible.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

341 ÷ 11 - 15 × 8 + 100 = 51
questions.solution:
The given equation:

341 ÷ 11 - 15 × 8 + 100 = 51

On interchanging × and -,

we get:

341 ÷ 11 × 15 - 8 + 100 = 51

⇒ 31 × 15 + 92 = 51

⇒ 557 = 51 (false)

**On interchanging - and +, **

**we get:

341 ÷ 11 + 15 × 8 - 100

⇒ 31 + 120 - 100 = 51

⇒ 31 + 20 = 51 (true)**

On interchanging × and +,

we get:

341 ÷ 11 - 15 + 8 × 100 = 51

⇒ 31 - 15 + 800 = 51

⇒ 816 = 51 (false)

On interchanging + and ÷,

we get:

341 + 11 - 15 × 8 ÷ 100 = 51

⇒ 352 - 1.2 = 51 

⇒ 350.8 = 51(false)

Hence, we need to interchange **+ and - **to make the equation correct.

questions.question: If EQUALITY is coded as 22832631827 and CONFIRM is coded as 2465211894, then how will RESOURCE be coded?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a628640c1a0f62c58f741c4c2f02d727b2b62abbcf256b5efee675ca988d976e.png] 

Each letter of the word is replaced by a number to form the code. If the position value of the letter is a single digit then the position value of the number opposite it (as per the above table) is used and if the position value of the letter has two digits then the sum of the digits is used.

For example, the position value of E as per the English alphabetical series is 5 which is a single digit, hence the position value of the letter opposite E in the table is used. V is opposite E in the table and its code is 22. Hence, the code for E is 22. Also, the position value of U is 21 which is a two-digit number, hence we will find the sum of the digits. Thus, the code for U will be 3.

Using the same criteria, we get:

For EQUALITY - 22832631827 as:

E (5) → V(22) → 22

Q (17) → 1 + 7 = 8

U (21) → 2 + 1 = 3

A (1) → Z (26) → 26

L (12) → 1 + 2 = 3

I (9) → R (18) → 18

T (20) → 2 + 0 = 2

Y (23) → 2 + 5 = 7

The code for CONFIRM is coded as 2465211894

C (3) → X(24) → 24

O (15) → 1 + 5 = 6

N (14) → 1 + 4 = 5

F (6) → U (21) → 21

I (9) → R (18) → 18

R (18) → 1 + 8 = 9 

M (13) → 1 + 3 = 4

Similarly,

R (18) → 1 + 8 = 9 

E (5) → V(22) → 22

S (19) → 1 + 9 = 10 

O (15) → 1 + 5 = 6

U (21) → 2 + 1 = 3

R (18) → 1 + 8 = 9 

C (3) → X(24) → 24

E (5) → V(22) → 22

Hence, the code for the word RESOURCE is **922106392422.**
